title: Reverse Bits
description: Reverse bits of a given 32 bits unsigned integer. Output the reversed integer as an unsigned decimal integer.
hints: Iterate 32 times: shift result left by 1 and OR with the i-th bit of n.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    ans = 0
    for i in range(32):
        ans = (ans << 1) | ((n >> i) & 1)
    print(ans)
